description: ops list with host.describe disabled, host.sleep enabled and its executable missing, files.sha256 enabled under an earlier definition, and host.nothing in the policy

stdout.name: host.describe
stdout.sends: Lucille gets the host's version and protocol, the operating system family, which release's catalog it has, which operations are on, the names you gave your folders (never where they are), and a fingerprint of the local policy.

stdout.name: host.sleep
stdout.summary: Wait up to 4 minutes, for testing
stdout.sends: Lucille gets how long the wait took and how it ended.

stdout.name: files.sha256
stdout.sends: Lucille gets a code that identifies the file's exact contents, not the contents.
